title: No tubas in the old bands; the Red Light job
summary: There were no tubas in bands until about 1920-21. The Magnolia Band worked nightly in the Red Light district at Huntz and Nagel's.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: What instrument did you play with? Bass violin? Bass violin.

Well there were no tubas in old bands back in them days. The tubas didn't come in the bands until around the 20s, 20s or 21. Then they started making tubas for the bands. So where did the Magnolia Band play? See we worked every night in the Red Electric District. After we were taking them. See the Superior Band sent us down there to work at their place and the man kept us. Where did you work down there? At this dance hall I was talking about, Hunter Snagel. Oh yeah.
